parent_objective: design scenario taxonomy after task-quality repair branch synthesis
blocked_by: need scenario taxonomy before another repair panel or controller-family comparison
supersedes: direct controller-family comparison on off-track-dominated public tasks

public_gates: M1727 must design a scenario taxonomy after M1726 without running rollout
M1727 must separate ordinary avoidance, AEB-infeasible stable AES, drift-required avoidance, unavoidable mitigation, off-track boundary stress, and hidden-dynamics stress
M1727 must define no-rollout materialization artifacts and pass/fail preflight checks for the next milestone
M1727 must preserve human-view/no-privileged actor input contract and controller-family controls
M1727 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout or rank controller families

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs scenario taxonomy after off-track repair branch synthesis identifies public off-track dominance
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: scenario taxonomy design only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if taxonomy collapses to another track-width/finish/max-step repair
stop if taxonomy omits unavoidable mitigation or drift-required tasks
stop if taxonomy lacks no-rollout preflight artifacts
stop if taxonomy changes actor inputs or ranks profiles
fallback_plan: route to taxonomy repair design if categories are underdefined
route to no-rollout scenario taxonomy preflight if design is complete
route to branch synthesis if taxonomy cannot separate task-quality from profile ranking
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1726 pivots from narrow off-track repair to scenario taxonomy

admission_evidence: M1726 finds narrow repair branch has conditional signal but high public overfit risk and off-track dominance
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1727 status queue scoreboard research log and review
next_stage_criteria: materialization and preflight checks are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; taxonomy design cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design must preserve L1, L2-current-tiled, L2 history-window, L3-online, and L3-reset controls for later execution
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If taxonomy cannot define scenarios that reduce public overfit risk, record that as scenario-design evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A paper-route scenario taxonomy can be designed to replace narrow public off-track repair with structured task-quality distributions before controller-family comparison.
success_criteria: taxonomy includes ordinary avoidance AEB-infeasible stable AES drift-required avoidance unavoidable mitigation off-track boundary stress and hidden-dynamics stress
no-rollout materialization inputs and outputs are specified
human-view actor input and controller-family controls remain unchanged
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: taxonomy is just another local repair axis
taxonomy ranks profiles or changes actor inputs
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1727 passes if it designs the scenario taxonomy and routes to no-rollout materialization without overclaiming.
